subject: Audit log sampling & temporary BYOK escrow window — decision needed
messages:
From: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@clearhealth.com>
To: mina_haddad@redwood.com
Cc: legal-procure@clearhealth.com
Date: 2027-04-12T09:13:00-07:00
Subject: Audit sampling + temporary BYOK escrow request

Hi Mina,

Thanks for taking this call yesterday. As discussed, ClearHealth has a hard requirement to limit retention of decrypted customer-level logs in vendor environments. For our pilot we need:

- A short-term BYOK escrow option where keys are escrowed to an auditable process for a predefined window (we suggested 30 days).
- A sampling plan for audit logs (we only need a representative sample for regulatory review) — target ~1-3% of sessions but across relevant user cohorts.
- A list of the exact artifacts you can provide (app logs, request/response headers, anonymized prompts).

I've attached a sample spec and our internal checklist. Can Redwood confirm feasibility and an action timeline? Contract is otherwise green.

Best,
Maria
Maria Gomez
Head of Security, ClearHealth
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@clearhealth.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-12T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Audit sampling + temporary BYOK escrow request

Hi Maria — thanks, and appreciated the clear checklist.

Quick triage from our side: Marcus (Product) and Grace (Security/Compliance) will scope what we can deliver from the hosted product and what requires a Dedicated/Private deployment. Ben (Ops) will confirm any infra constraints on short-lived escrow windows.

Initial notes:
- Temporary escrow (30d) is plausible but needs an ops playbook for key retrieval, audit trail, and automatic purge.
- Sampling at scale can be done via our audit-exports pipeline; need to finalize the sampling algorithm (random vs. stratified) to satisfy your regulators.

Requesting: can you confirm the compliance reviewers' minimum sample size and whether anonymized prompts are acceptable? That will determine whether we need a broader export.

We'll aim to return a proposed plan by EOD Thursday (2027-04-15).

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Director, Compliance Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: mina_haddad@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-13T09:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Audit sampling + temporary BYOK escrow request

Adding technical detail from product side.

Options we should consider:
1) Hosted short-window BYOK escrow: implement an escrow API where a customer key is encrypted with an HSM-wrapped escrow key and stored with purge metadata. Retrieval requires a signed retrieval ticket and is logged. Pros: fastest to implement as a gated feature flag. Cons: adds uplift to hosted SLA and we must harden access controls.

2) Dedicated-only escrow: run an operator-managed escrow process within a Dedicated pool; better isolation, but procurement cycle longer.

Sampling approach: recommend stratified sampling by tenant + time-window to ensure representation across cohorts; 2% is a reasonable starting point for ClearHealth size, but need their population counts.

Attachments: I exported a rough flow diagram (byok_escrow_flow_v2.png) and a draft sampling spec (audit_sample_spec.xlsx).

Question for Grace: what evidence artifacts meet audit standards? Full request/response bodies or redacted snapshots?

Will draft the plan and a runbook for ops for Thursday.

- Marcus
Product Lead, Serving Platform
From: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@clearhealth.com>
To: mina_haddad@redwood.com
Cc: legal-procure@clearhealth.com
Date: 2027-04-14T08:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Audit sampling + temporary BYOK escrow request

Thanks Mina/Marcus. A few clarifications from our side:

- Sample size: our external auditor requested a minimum of 500 audited events per quarter per regulated workflow. For the pilot (one workflow), 500 events is the floor. If ClearHealth sessions are smaller than that in a 30-day window, we might accept 100% of sessions for that workflow.
- Artifacts: anonymized prompts and truncated responses are acceptable; we cannot share PHI or direct identifiers. Headers + metadata (tenant id, timestamp, event type) are required.
- Escrow retrieval: must be limited to a documented approval chain (ClearHealth security lead + Redwood head of ops) and each retrieval must produce a signed attestation.

Procurement note: we will need the escrow flow documented in the SOW and the 30-day purge clause called out.

Let us know if the 500-event floor is feasible with stratified sampling.

Maria
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: mina_haddad@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: maria.gomez@clearhealth.com
Date: 2027-04-15T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Audit sampling + temporary BYOK escrow request — proposed decision

Team — proposed triage and decision to share with ClearHealth:  

1) Sampling: Offer a stratified sample targeting 2% of sessions with an explicit guarantee of at least 500 audited events for the specified workflow (we will increase window to 60 days if needed to hit 500).
2) BYOK escrow: Approve a hosted short-window escrow (30 days) with the following controls: HSM-wrapped escrow key, retrieval via DocuSign-approved retrieval ticket + two-person approval (ClearHealth security lead + Redwood Ops lead), immutable audit trail stored for 1 year.
3) Artifacts: Provide headers, timestamps, tenant id, anonymized prompts, and truncated responses — no PHI. We will include the exact artifact set in the SOW.
4) Next steps: Mina to update SOW language (escrow + purge clause). Marcus to finalize sampling runbook and provide a CSV of sample selection methodology. Ben to author ops playbook for retrieval and purge automation.

I will loop Maria and Legal with an updated SOW and runbook by EOD Friday. If anyone has objections to the 30-day escrow window or the 2% target, flag now.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
